events.detail: round 1 revision scored 0 < best 5; rolled back

addressed.claim_id: _money() previously quantized immediately without checking decimal places, silently rounding values like "10.005" via ROUND_HALF_EVEN.
Added explicit validation using amount.as_tuple().exponent < -2 to raise ValueError for more than 2 fraction digits before quantizing.
Only after validation does quantization to 2dp occur, now using ROUND_HALF_UP to pad to exactly 2dp.
